name: 68124 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68124 (Omaha) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68124 (Omaha) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68124 (Omaha) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
